title: AI compute provider Nscale is looking for $3.5B in pre-IPO financing
summary: Nscale, which recently struck a $45 billion deal with Anthropic, is in talks to raise additional funds in anticipation of an upcoming IPO.
llm_summary: Nscale, a fast‑growing AI‑compute provider that recently secured a massive $45 billion partnership with Anthropic, is now courting investors for a $3.5 billion pre‑IPO financing round. The fresh capital is intended to fuel its expansion and set the stage
